description: PicoBoy Color Plus in C: create a project from the book template, run, debug and profile it in the PBConPC emulator.
command.newProject: New Project from the Book Template
command.profile: Profiler: Where Does the Time Go?
config.title: PBC+
config.pbconpcPath: Path to PBConPC (on Windows `pbconpc.exe`). Empty: search the PATH, which finds it on Linux after installing the .deb package.
config.gdbPath: Path to the GDB debugger. Empty: `gdb-multiarch` on Linux, otherwise the GDB of the Raspberry Pi Pico extension.
config.usbTerminal: Show a terminal next to the screen in the PBConPC window, with everything the program prints with `printf`.
config.exactTiming: Device-accurate timing for display and sensor when running (`--exact-bus`). Slower, but closer to the PBC+. The profiler always measures this way.
config.hideDebugBuildHint: Do not remind about "set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Debug)" before debugging.
config.templateUrl: Where the project template is downloaded from. Without internet the extension uses its bundled copy.
capabilities.untrusted: In Restricted Mode you can create a new project and use the editor help. Building, running and debugging need a trusted folder.
